Sandbox_HARMONIE_LifestyleAudioTuneVolum: Multiplies the volume of Lifestyle: Hobbies' DJ Booth song and instrument-playing/training sounds, live, while playing. 1.0 = the mod's own original volume, lower = quieter. Does not affect the Jukebox song (right-click the Jukebox -> Jukebox Volume for that) or the Disco Ball, which are not hooked live and stay at this mod's static reduced volume.
